answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade: the stake is locked like timber in a frame, and any proven fake identity loses it. A lantern of public reputation then hangs over each stake — peers can see which identities carry real collateral and which are hollow. Sybil attackers must fund every fake identity, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs; quartz-clear accounting makes the cost visible to all.
